# dify_default_model (Resource)

Sets the workspace's default model of one model type (`llm`, `text-embedding`, `rerank`, `speech2text`, `tts`, `moderation`). The API has no way to unset a default, so destroy only removes this resource from state — the configured default stays in place on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Set the workspace default model for a model type.
resource "dify_default_model" "llm" {
  model_type    = "llm"
  provider_name = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  model         = "gpt-4o-mini"
}
```

~> **Note:** the Dify OpenAPI has no "unset default" operation, so `terraform destroy` only removes this resource from Terraform state — the server-side default model is left unchanged.

## Schema

### Required

- `model` (String) Model name used as the default.
- `model_type` (String) Model type the default applies to.
- `provider_name` (String) Provider id of the default model (e.g. `langgenius/openai/openai`).
